decisions.rationale: “The joystick was in manual mode” asserts episode state without qualification. The evidence establishes only that the latest received manual-priority indicator was ON; its upstream state is not time-filtered. That does not establish actual manual mode at the asserted episode scope.

“The joystick was in manual mode” does not preserve the supported diagnostic's latest-received indicator scope. The response supplies neither that bounded observation nor another supported diagnostic alternative, so the diagnostic unit is not communicated.
